narration: Here's what nobody tells you: every rent check you send is quietly building your landlord's wealth, not yours. And the numbers are wild.
visual: Person silhouette on left handing dollar bills to a house with a bank icon above it. Dollar signs float from person to house. Dark background. Text overlay: 'WHOSE WEALTH ARE YOU BUILDING?'

narration: The average American pays $1,702 a month in rent. Over ten years that's $204,240 straight out of your pocket — and you keep exactly zero of it.
visual: Large animated number counter rising to $204,240. Stack of cash bills shrinking as counter climbs. Light background. Text: '$204,240 PAID. $0 KEPT.'

narration: Meanwhile your landlord quietly built $95,900 in equity from those same payments. Mortgage principal dropped. Property appreciated. Your housing net worth? Still zero.
visual: Split screen: left bar chart labeled LANDLORD grows to $95,900 in green. Right bar labeled YOU stays flat at $0. Dark background. Red highlight on the $0 bar.

narration: Renters tell themselves it's about flexibility — but 63% say they plan to buy someday, and most never do. That's not a plan, that's procrastination with a price tag.
visual: Person silhouette with thought bubble containing a small house and the word SOMEDAY. Calendar with pages flipping. Light background. Text: '63% PLAN TO BUY. FEW EVER DO.'

narration: A mortgage payment is often similar to rent — but part of it comes back to you as equity. After ten years that's nearly $100K in net worth instead of nothing.
visual: Two side-by-side payment bars: MORTGAGE bar split with green equity slice and dark interest slice. RENT bar entirely dark with '$0 BACK' label. Dark background.

narration: Run the numbers for your city. Because staying a renter is a choice — and most people don't realize it's the most expensive housing decision they'll ever make.
visual: Calculator icon with house SVG. Piggy bank gradually filling on one side. Arrow pointing upward. Light background. Large text: 'RUN YOUR NUMBERS' with red accent underline.
